_source: Geography (bodies, lattice), Factions 'Region by region' (holders), Official Map (label, chart position). chartPos is the box center in pixels on the official map image (data/raw/images/Official_Map/media/image1.png, coreward up, trailing right). It is a 2D layout hint only; the documents give no 3D coordinates.

regions.name: Ostrom
regions.label: gate, Marrow

stars.name: Ostrom
stars.notes: Six planets, none habitable. The gate hangs beyond the outermost orbit. The colony hauler Anselm fell into this star at the Closing.

stars.name: Cinder
stars.notes: Burned out. Scatter of airless planets. Nine hours from Ostrom by local lane. Stewardship picket.

stars.name: Marl
stars.notes: Thick asteroid belt; source of the Marrow's raw material and Ostrom's lattice nodules.

bodies.name: Ostrom IV
bodies.notes: Cold super-Earth, thin nitrogen atmosphere, nothing worth landing for.

bodies.name: The Marrow
bodies.notes: Basin capital. Hollowed nickel-iron asteroid in high orbit around the flagship Bellwether. ~200,000 people. Hangar Ring, the Exchange, Assay House, the Stacks, Command spine, the Cold Hold (140,000 sleepers), Vigil chapel on the outer hull.

bodies.name: The gate
bodies.notes: Ring ~2,000 km across beyond the outermost planet. Space around it unusually clean. THRESHOLD's research platform is nearby.

bodies.name: The Silent Mouths
bodies.notes: Three silent lane mouths a few million km from the gate on its far side. Lead to the Quiet.

bodies.name: IPS-N Ostrom yards
bodies.notes: Only place in the Basin that can refit a capital ship.

regions.notes: Six primary lane mouths: Tallis, Gloam, Scald and the three Silent Mouths.

stars.name: Tallis
stars.notes: Primary of the garden world Tallis.

stars.name: Brace
stars.notes: A few hours trailing. No habitable worlds. Holds the lane mouth to Halyard. Stewardship picket.

stars.name: Marchwell
stars.notes: Coreward. Dim. Holds the mouth of the lane to Pennant.

bodies.name: Tallis
bodies.notes: Largest garden world in the Basin. Mild, wet. Two continents, two small moons. River valleys on the larger continent's east side; the Reach is the dry interior upland. Eleven Absent climate structures mapped several km down (first found 5021u). Places: the Landing (east coast), Dry Creek, Sallow Ford.

bodies.name: Pennant
bodies.notes: Cool forested garden world, long winters. Northern continent (fjords, river valleys) holds the Synod settlements. Empty southern continent has the largest Absent climate structure: a 40 km ring of bare rock. Corvel's besieged landing is there.

bodies.name: Orison
bodies.notes: Garden world whose climate machinery is failing. Longer winters, stronger storms, sea surges inland. ~40,000 settlers. Tidal lane mouth to Gloam lies at the edge of the region.

bodies.name: Wending
bodies.notes: Ocean world, no continents, volcanic archipelagos. ~30 floating lagoon towns on cables. Two large moons, heavy tides.

stars.name: Lantern stars
stars.notes: Brighten and dim together every 73 days. Tidal lanes across the Basin follow this cycle.

bodies.name: Verdance
bodies.notes: Garden world, machinery runs hot. 200 m forests, frame-killing predators. Two settlement attempts abandoned (5024u, 5026u); Verdance Colonial Company preparing a third.

bodies.name: Stillwater
bodies.notes: Ocean world, no tides, almost no wind. City-sized Absent platforms float on it; one settled by the Long Families (5025u).

bodies.name: (four unnamed garden worlds)
bodies.notes: Seen only from orbit.

regions.name: The Pale
regions.label: dead stars
regions.notes: Dim, cold, airless worlds. A repeating Absent signal broadcasts every 41 hours from somewhere inside; source never found. Survey Office research station.

lattice.where: Veins in the central structure only

stars.name: (red dwarf)
stars.notes: Several light-hours away; lights the worlds faintly.

bodies.name: Central structure
bodies.notes: Dark Absent object about the size of a small moon. No star at the center. Warms the worlds.

bodies.name: (nine worlds)
bodies.notes: Orbits in exact resonance; alignment never the same between visits.

regions.name: Halyard
regions.label: Free Lines

bodies.name: Halyard Station
bodies.notes: Anchored to a shattered ice moon in a wide orbit in the largest system. Free Lines home. Wending passage mouth nearby.

regions.notes: Comets and ice moons; water and reaction mass for the trailing arm.

lattice.where: Seams in the orange dwarfs' metal worlds

bodies.name: Lumen's moon
bodies.notes: Single large rocky, tidally heated moon. Volcanic belts. Holds Lumen Station (Smith-Shimano).

bodies.name: Sable Harbor
bodies.notes: Port built from moored hulls around the largest dark moonlet.

regions.name: The Furnace
regions.label: nebula
regions.notes: Stellar nursery. Radiation blinds sensors and burns unshielded electronics. Even local lanes drift. Unidentified anchorages deep inside. Visible from Lumen's moon.

regions.name: The Hollows
regions.label: rogue worlds

lattice.where: Seams under the ice of rogue worlds

regions.notes: No stars. Rogue planets kept warm by Absent heat engines; liquid oceans under ice. Rimelight runs four stations on three rogue worlds (lost a fifth to the Unlit). Local lanes short and stable.

lattice.where: Seams through the frozen night side

bodies.name: Gloam
bodies.notes: Tidally locked. Desert day side, frozen night side full of lattice; settlements in the twilight band. Custodians below ~400 m. Orbital guns cover both lane mouths; Purview orbital yards. ~110,000 people.

lattice.where: Thin seams on a few moons

bodies.name: Halvard
bodies.notes: A dozen moons. Storm larger than Tallis, stationary for 12 years. Halvard Gap mouth near its rings.

bodies.name: Halvard's Rest
bodies.notes: Largest moon. Ice world, thin atmosphere, subsurface ocean. Lattice refinery. ~25,000 people under Mercer-Ibarra.

lattice.where: Shallow seams on small worlds; Choir's rings (exceptional)

stars.name: (dozens of small systems)
stars.notes: Local lanes drift faster than anywhere else.

bodies.name: Choir
bodies.notes: Rings almost pure lattice. Local lane to it drifts very fast.

bodies.name: Bellows
bodies.notes: Cold rocky world; breathable 5 months a year. ~4,000 settlers in sealed towns (Bellows Commune).

bodies.name: Scald
bodies.notes: Hot, dry, thin air. Nearly half the surface fused to glass. Custodians below ~400 m. Places: the Seam (600 km front), Kettle Flats (Northern Concord), Kerrtown (Kerr-Varga, southern edge of the glassfields).

regions.name: Ferrous
regions.label: foundries
regions.notes: Almost no planets; dense metal-rich asteroid belts. The Basin's largest foundries are built into the biggest asteroids.

regions.name: Tarn
regions.label: Absent yards

bodies.name: Tarn
bodies.notes: Cold rocky planet with very broad rings. Ruined Absent shipyard inside the rings (found 5025u). Basin Office survey stations; Rimelight receiving station.

regions.notes: Four lane mouths; one of the busiest rimward junctions.

lattice.where: Shallow seams under the stone fields

bodies.name: Cairn
bodies.notes: Cold, cloudy, dense atmosphere. Colonial organisms build moving stone structures that respond to lattice; possible sapience under Bench review.

bodies.name: Ashlar
bodies.notes: Airless world; field of empty Absent stone towers, some over 1 km tall. Only known above-ground Absent construction. First crew lost 19 hours (5026u). Survey Office quarantine.

regions.name: The Boneyard
regions.label: Absent wrecks
regions.notes: Moon-sized Absent megastructures drifting in loose orbits. Custodians more common here than anywhere. Some wrecks still powered.

regions.name: The Mire
regions.label: dust and drift
regions.notes: Dark dust cloud hiding its stars. Local lanes branch and rejoin unpredictably. Some stars known only from the lanes.

regions.name: The Quiet
regions.label: Silent Mouths
regions.notes: Whatever lies beyond Ostrom's Silent Mouths. Every probe sent in has vanished. Distance unknown.
